title: Sorting the Sentence
approach: Place words by their trailing position digit
statement: Rearrange words into the order specified by each word's trailing position digit.
explanation: Allocate a word array and place each word at its one-based position.
example: s="is2 sentence4 This1 a3" -> "This is a sentence"

title: Sum of All Subset XOR Totals
statement: Return the sum of the bitwise XOR of every subset of nums.
explanation: Enumerate subset masks, compute each subset XOR, and add it to the total.

title: Substrings of Size Three with Distinct Characters
statement: Count substrings of length three whose characters are all distinct.
explanation: For each window of length three, compare its three characters or count its distinct set size.

title: Check if Word Equals Summation of Two Words
statement: Map each letter a..j to digit 0..9 and check whether the first two word values sum to the third.
explanation: Convert each word's letters to their corresponding decimal digits, then compare integer values.

title: Determine Whether Matrix Can Be Obtained By Rotation
statement: Return true if rotating the square matrix by 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees yields target.
explanation: Compare the current matrix with target and rotate clockwise up to four times.

title: Check if All the Integers in a Range Are Covered
approach: Verify every integer in the range
statement: Return true if every integer from left through right is included in at least one interval.
explanation: For each required integer, check whether any interval covers it.

title: Largest Odd Number in String
statement: Return the largest-valued odd-number prefix of num, or an empty string if none exists.
explanation: Scan from the end for the first odd digit and return the prefix through that position.

title: Build Array from Permutation
explanation: For each value x in nums, append nums[x].

title: Concatenation of Array
approach: Append a copy of the array
statement: Return the array followed by an identical copy of itself.
explanation: Allocate a result twice as long and copy nums into both halves.

title: Check if All Characters Have Equal Number of Occurrences
statement: Return true if every distinct character in s occurs the same number of times.
explanation: Count each character and verify all positive frequencies are equal.
